essence: Offering libation with waters visualized as milk grants the practitioner a son.
When vital wounds are decisively cut, demons are destroyed.
After meditation, the practitioner should feed them the remnants of Kṛṣṇa's oblation.
The rite frees children from planetary afflictions and destroys their diseases.
Repeating the mantra ten thousand times pacifies multitudes of obstacles.
